easyPrerequisites: An opponent must control a creature.
description:
Cast Shifting Grift for its first spree cost by paying {2}{U}{U}, exchanging control of a creature an opponent controls and Surrak.
Activate Soltari Guerrillas an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Surrak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing its controller to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
